items.title: Jonathan Ross 'horrified' by Walliams allegations and Brand conviction
items.summary: The TV presenter says he was once "friendly" with David Walliams and Russell Brand, but was "genuinely unaware" of their conduct.

items.title: 'I felt like I was being manipulated': Woman alleges Walliams groomed her as a teenager
items.summary: Lilly Creightmore, who has alleged Walliams "groomed" her as a teenager, has told BBC Newsnight that she was "angry" at his behaviour.

items.title: Scottish DJ, 32, confirmed as victim of Krakow shooting
items.summary: The man, who is understood to be James Thomas Campbell from Prestwick, died when a lone gunman opened fire in central Krakow on Saturday.

items.title: Spain sees widespread disruption in first general strike for 14 years
items.summary: Protests are also expected in the biggest cities less than three weeks before Spaniards vote in parliamentary elections.

items.title: Watch: UK falls silent to mark Armistice Day
items.summary: People from Belfast to Cardiff, London to Edinburgh held the two-minute silence to mark the end of World War One and to remember those who have died in conflicts.

items.title: Police helped remove Russell Brand after 'violent incident' at Jemima Goldsmith's home
items.summary: Police confirm they asked Brand to leave his ex-girlfriend's house after she reported an alleged assault.

items.title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive
items.summary: Thousands of messages seen by BBC show how a Chinese official sought details of sensitive political matters.

items.title: Hundreds of Italian schools hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
items.summary: Emails containing the false warnings were sent to schools in Rome, Naples, Vicenza, Florence, Pisa, Trieste and other Italian cities, officials say.
